decree: قرار مجلس إدارة هيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك رقم (01-03-25)

predecessor_regulation.note: الﻼئحة التنفيذية السابقة لضريبة التصرفات العقارية، مذكورة بالاسم والتاريخ مرتين في المادة الرابعة عشرة (الأحكام الختامية) من هذه اللائحة لأغراض انتقالية (سقف احتساب الغرامات عن فترة ما قبل سريان النظام، ومدة طلب الاسترداد)، دون نص صريح يلغيها. النص الكامل لهذا القرار الوزاري لم يُستخرج ضمن هذا المسار.

verification_methodology_note:
PRIMARY SOURCE: this track's full verbatim Arabic text of all 15 articles was extracted directly from the born-digital PDF published by the issuing Authority at zatca.gov.sa/ar/RulesRegulations/Taxes/Documents/New%20Rett%20Regulation.pdf (HTTP 200, 21 pages, downloaded directly -- no proxy needed for the fetch itself). laws.boe.gov.sa was checked first per this corpus's standard methodology: a direct search on the BOE portal returns ONLY the base RETT Law's existing lawId page (eef585a5-c63a-4906-a951-b208009b3eff, already tracked in this corpus as sources/rett/), confirming -- as with this corpus's vat_regulation and income_tax_regulation tracks -- that Board-level Implementing Regulations are not catalogued as their own standalone lawId records on BOE. uqn.gov.sa (Umm al-Qura Gazette portal, direct fetch of the issue-5080 archive page) and the Wayback Machine both returned unreachable/blocked in this environment (see known_unresolved_discrepancies); the r.jina.ai read-proxy fallback returned HTTP 401/503 on the specific uqn.gov.sa URLs tried this pass.

EXTRACTION METHODOLOGY (two independent pipelines, reconciled): the source PDF stores Arabic in presentation forms with the same systematic bidi/justification ordering defect documented for this corpus's vat_regulation track (word order scrambled on justified lines, list-marker digits/letters visually similar to each other post-OCR). Two independent extractions were reconciled: (1) Tesseract Arabic OCR (--psm 6) of 300dpi PyMuPDF page renders -- correct reading order and correct tanwin/punctuation, but with occasional character-level misreads, most often confusable Arabic list letters/digits (e.g. the sub-item letter 'هـ' misread as the digit '4'; the number '10.' misread as '0.'; '12.' as '2.'; '17.' as '77.'; '20.' as '0.'; '21.' as '1.' -- i.e. a leading digit dropped) and stray inserted/garbled characters (e.g. 'ء' insertions, '؛' for '،'); (2) PyMuPDF character-exact line-level geometric extraction (RTL-reversed word order but exact source glyphs), used specifically to VERIFY every percentage, day-count, year-count and the Ministerial Resolution number/date against the exact source digits, and to correct the OCR list-marker misreads identified above by cross-referencing the parallel, already-tracked enumeration in the base RETT Law's Article 3(a) (21 exemption categories, sources/rett/law/official_source/rett_law_official_source.json), which this Regulation's Article 3(a) elaborates in the identical 1-21 order. All of the following were independently verified character-by-character against the PyMuPDF geometric extraction and confirmed correct: the 5% base rate (Art. 2/a), the 50% real-estate-company asset threshold and 365-day look-back (Art. 2/h), the 30% share-transfer threshold appearing twice (Art. 2/i), the 2% monthly penalty, the 50% penalty cap (twice), and the 1% additional penalty (all Art. 14/b), and the predecessor regulation's number and date, '(712)' and '15/02/1442هـ' (Art. 14/b and 14/c). Diacritics (tashkeel) and tatweel are stripped/normalized uniformly, consistent with this corpus's other tracks. No paragraph or article was dropped: the 15 article headers (المادة الأولى through المادة الخامسة عشرة) were located and used as structural anchors, and the sub-item counts of Article 3(a) (1-21) and Article 11 (سبعة/eight-plus lettered sub-blocks) were checked for a complete, unbroken run. Arabic governs; no translation/paraphrase/interpretation performed.

CROSS-VERIFICATION: the decision number (01-03-25), its date (24/09/1446هـ, printed on the source PDF's own cover as corresponding to '24/03/2025م' -- verified independently via the Hijri calendar: 1 Ramadan 1446H falls around 1 March 2025G, so 24 Ramadan 1446H = 24 March 2025G, consistent with the PDF's own printed Gregorian equivalent), and the 15-article count were independently corroborated against snadlaw.sa (which reproduces an article-by-article topic summary matching this track's own article boundaries and titles exactly, 1 through 15) and qanoonsa.com (which additionally confirms Umm al-Qura Gazette Issue (5080)). Umm al-Qura Gazette Issue 5080's own publication date was independently located via web search as 11/10/1446هـ (Shawwal), which converts to approximately 9 April 2025G -- consistent with the ~9-10 April 2025G effective/publication date widely reported by PwC, EY, KPMG and Deloitte tax alerts, and with this corpus's own rett_law track's Law effective date (180 days after the Law's own 11 Oct 2024G Gazette publication). These are three legitimately DIFFERENT dates for three different events -- Board decision (24 March 2025G), Gazette publication (~9 April 2025G), and entry into force (~9-10 April 2025G, coinciding with the base Law's own effective date) -- not a contradiction; each is recorded separately below.

IMPORTANT CORRECTION TO THIS TRACK'S PRIOR-RESEARCH BRIEF: the brief that commissioned this track asserted the new 15-article Regulation was 'later amended per SPA (spa.gov.sa/N2095607) and argaam.com'. Independent verification this pass shows this is NOT correct as stated. spa.gov.sa/N2095607 and the matching Argaam coverage (articledetail/id/1724381 and id/1536418) are dated 3-4 May 2024 (24 Shawwal 1445H) -- eleven months BEFORE this Regulation (Board Decision 01-03-25) was even issued (24 March 2025G) or published (~9 April 2025G). It is therefore chronologically impossible for that May 2024 SPA/Argaam item to describe an amendment OF this Regulation. Reading the underlying content confirms this: the May 2024 SPA/Argaam item describes amendments to the PRE-EXISTING Implementing Regulation of the Real Estate Transaction Tax issued by Ministerial Resolution No. (712) dated 15/2/1442H (~2 Oct 2020G) -- the Regulation that predates both this track's Regulation and the 2024 RETT Law itself -- specifically touching property-to-company transfer exemptions, real-estate-investment-fund in-kind contribution exemptions, a public-offering carve-out from 5-year clawback conditions, and the BOOT-contract tax-accrual date. This predecessor Regulation (712, 15/2/1442H) 'and its amendments' (وتعديلاتها) is explicitly named -- by number and date -- TWICE in this track's own Article 14 (transitional/closing provisions), for grandfathering penalty calculations and refund-claim windows for the pre-Law period; it is NOT otherwise repealed or superseded by name anywhere in this Regulation's 15 articles. This track's OWN 15-article text, by contrast, shows NO evidence of any amendment since its 24 March/9 April 2025 issuance through the current date (25 July 2026) -- extensive web search for post-issuance ZATCA Board amendment decisions to Resolution (01-03-25) itself returned none. Accordingly all 15 articles are recorded as اصلية (original, unamended).

known_unresolved_discrepancies.description: The task brief that commissioned this track cited spa.gov.sa/N2095607 and argaam.com as evidence this Regulation 'was later amended'. Independent verification shows those items are dated 3-4 May 2024 (24 Shawwal 1445H), predating this Regulation's own issuance (24 March 2025G) and publication (~9 April 2025G) by roughly eleven months. They in fact describe amendments to the PRE-EXISTING, PREDECESSOR Implementing Regulation issued by Ministerial Resolution No. (712) dated 15/2/1442H (~2 Oct 2020G) -- not to this track's 15-article Regulation (Board Decision 01-03-25). See verification_methodology_note for the full chronology. This track's OWN text shows no amendment since issuance; all 15 articles are recorded as اصلية.

This Regulation's own Article 14 (الأحكام الختامية) names, by number and date, a predecessor Implementing Regulation of the Real Estate Transaction Tax issued by Ministerial Resolution No. (712) dated 15/2/1442H ('وتعديلاتها' -- 'and its amendments'), twice: once for grandfathering penalty-calculation caps for the pre-Law non-payment period, and once for the refund-claim window for tax refundable under that predecessor Regulation. This Regulation's own text does NOT contain a clause expressly repealing or superseding Resolution 712; the transition from the old regime to the new one is handled entirely through Article 14's transitional/grandfather provisions (mirroring this corpus's rett_law track's own documented approach of not asserting a named-repeal claim beyond what the primary text states). The full verbatim text of Ministerial Resolution 712 (15/2/1442H) was NOT retrieved this pass and is not part of this track.

Three legitimately different dates attach to this Regulation and are not to be conflated: (1) Board of Directors decision date, printed on the source PDF's own cover as '24/09/1446هـ الموافق 24/03/2025م' (24 March 2025G) -- independently confirmed via Hijri-calendar conversion (1 Ramadan 1446H ≈ 1 March 2025G) and corroborated by snadlaw.sa's independent citation of the same decision date; (2) Umm al-Qura Gazette publication, Issue (5080), located via web search as dated 11/10/1446H (Shawwal), ≈ 9 April 2025G, consistent with qanoonsa.com's and multiple Big-4 tax alerts' citation of 9 April 2025 as the Gazette date; (3) entry into force, per this Regulation's own Article 15 ('ويعمل بها من تاريخ نفاذ النظام' -- effective from the Law's own effective date), coinciding with the base RETT Law's 180-day effective date (≈ 9-10 April 2025G, already documented in this corpus's rett_law track). These three dates are consistent with one another and with the public record; none is treated here as a conflict.

Consistent with this corpus's vat_regulation and income_tax_regulation tracks, laws.boe.gov.sa has NO dedicated lawId page for this Board-level Implementing Regulation; a direct site search returns only the base RETT Law's own existing lawId page (eef585a5-c63a-4906-a951-b208009b3eff), already tracked in this corpus at sources/rett/. zatca.gov.sa (the issuing Authority's own site) is therefore the primary source for this track's text, as it was for vat_regulation and income_tax_regulation.

Direct fetch of uqn.gov.sa (Umm al-Qura Gazette portal) pages for Issue 5080 returned HTTP 503 in this environment; the r.jina.ai read-proxy fallback returned HTTP 401 on the specific uqn.gov.sa URLs attempted this pass. web.archive.org / Wayback Machine egress is blocked at the network layer in this environment, per this corpus's standing note (also documented in the rett_law track). The Gazette issue number (5080) and its publication date (11/10/1446H ≈ 9 April 2025G) are therefore corroborated via web search citations of the Gazette (qanoonsa.com, multiple news/tax alerts) rather than via a direct primary fetch of the Gazette PDF itself; the Regulation's operative TEXT (all 15 articles) was, by contrast, fetched directly and primarily from zatca.gov.sa (HTTP 200), not from the Gazette.

The source PDF exhibits the same systematic Arabic bidi/justification text-ordering defect documented for this corpus's vat_regulation track. This track's text was reconciled from two independent extractions -- Tesseract Arabic OCR of 300dpi page renders (correct reading order; occasional character-level misreads) and PyMuPDF character-exact geometric extraction (exact glyphs, RTL-reversed order) -- with every percentage, day/year count, and the predecessor regulation's number/date cross-checked digit-by-digit against the geometric extraction, and OCR list-marker misreads (confusable digit/letter pairs, detailed in verification_methodology_note) corrected by cross-referencing the parallel, already-verified 21-item enumeration in this corpus's own rett_law Article 3(a). A small residual risk of unflagged character-level OCR error in long prose passages (as opposed to numbers/list-markers, which were specifically verified) cannot be fully excluded and is disclosed here rather than silently assumed away.
